newsitem.title: JAPAN: Takara Shuzo plans briefing, won't give details.
newsitem.headline: Takara Shuzo plans briefing, won't give details.

text.p: Takara Shuzo Co Ltd said on Thursday it plans to hold a news conference later in the day but company spokesmen declined to comment further.
Jiji news agency said the company would hold a news conference on a products recall at 2 p.m. (0500 GMT) in Kyoto, western Japan, where the company is based.
Takara Shuzo makes products such as distilled spirits, alcoholic beverages and soft drinks.
Shares of Takara Shuzo weakened on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the morning, falling 20 yen to 1,100 by the midday break.
